question: What different outcomes follow from oblations associated with the ear versus the eye?
premises: An oblation in the ear locus brings freedom from disease.
An oblation in the eye locus brings blindness.
These outcomes are declared in the teaching.
inference: Ear-associated oblation is beneficial, while eye-associated oblation is harmful.
plain_english: In an ear oblation there would be freedom from disease, but in the eye blindness is declared.
